source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Generate event-logs in SUT firstly.
2. Enter BIOS -> Event Logs -> View Smbios Event Log, and then check current event-logs.
3. Enter BIOS -> Event Logs -> Change Smbios Event Log Settings, set "Erase Event Log" to "Yes, Next reset", and then save & exit.
4. Enter BIOS -> Event Logs -> View Smbios Event Log, and then check event-logs should be erased.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Information of event-logs should be correct.
2. Event-logs can be erased successfully.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Event Logs: generate event logs in the SUT, read and then erase them. Agent can read/clear the BMC SEL sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sel list 2>&1 | tail -n 30 2>&1" ; generating the events and confirming successful erase is an operator/IPMI write flow.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the tail of the current SEL so the operator confirms the event information is correct and can be erased.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: clearing the SEL removes all event records; capture the log first.

original_test_intent: Generate known SUT events, visually verify their information in the BIOS Miramar SMBIOS Event Log, arm Erase Event Log for the next reset, and visually confirm that this same BIOS log is erased after save, exit and reset.
original_method: Confirm the platform recipe, capture all logs, create an approved event stimulus, inspect the BIOS Event Logs pages, select Yes, Next reset, save and exit, re-enter BIOS to verify erasure, and retain photographs plus post-test OS/BMC health logs.
manual_activity: A human must observe the event records on the named BIOS SMBIOS page, change Erase Event Log to Yes, Next reset, save/exit, and re-enter BIOS to observe the cleared state. Agent-collected BMC SEL or OS logs are corroboration only.
required_inputs: Approved event stimulus and expected SMBIOS event encoding
BIOS console operator and capture method
safety_requirements: Archive the complete BIOS SMBIOS log and independent BMC/OS logs before any erase action.
Use only an approved non-damaging event stimulus; do not guess a fault injection command.
Obtain one-authorized-user approval for the unchanged erase/reset plan and drain workloads.
Do not use BMC SEL clear as a substitute or supplementary cleanup unless separately authorized.
Stop on ambiguous log target, unexpected health degradation, failed boot or lost management access.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only platform identity, OS logs and BMC SEL before and after the approved sequence.
Correlate timestamps and expected event fields with operator-supplied BIOS captures.
Archive evidence and report discrepancies without claiming the BIOS observation, erase result or final verdict.
engineer_actions: Define and approve the event stimulus and expected BIOS record.
Approve destruction of log history and the reset window.
Perform/capture the BIOS observations and setting change.
Determine PASS/FAIL from the complete evidence.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The proposed ipmitool sel list command addresses the BMC SEL and cannot prove the BIOS SMBIOS Event Log content or erasure. Its tail -n 30 also risks omitting relevant pre-clear records.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain ipmitool only for full supplementary BMC SEL archival after credential-safe invocation; use the preserved BIOS/Miramar path and reviewed project script for the actual target.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The BIOS paths, Yes, Next reset value, script URL and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture the complete BIOS SMBIOS log photograph/export and full BMC/OS logs with synchronized timestamps, execute one approved stimulus, then prove both the pre-clear record and post-reset empty BIOS state without conflating log stores.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, BMC, ipmitool and project-script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BIOS Event Log specification and owner-approved stimulus procedure.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit log-store separation, full pre-clear archival and timestamp correlation while retaining the original BIOS workflow.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; supplementary BMC/OS visibility is added.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Vendor event semantics and expected fields.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC SEL and SMBIOS Event Log may record different events and clearing one does not prove the other was cleared.

project_override_considerations: The project may choose the safe event stimulus, retention path and maintenance window. It may not replace BIOS SMBIOS evidence with BMC SEL output or omit the named erase-on-next-reset behavior.
expected_evidence: Board, BIOS/Miramar and BMC identity plus approved plan
Complete pre-clear BIOS SMBIOS log and independent BMC/OS archives
Stimulus record and expected-to-actual event-field correlation
BIOS captures of the event, Yes, Next reset setting and save/exit
Post-reset BIOS capture proving the same log is erased
Post-test BMC/OS health, final setting state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently target the BIOS SMBIOS Event Log. The absent event recipe and expected values are project readiness inputs; DeepSeek's BMC SEL substitution is a review defect, not a source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intent and manual BIOS workflow are clear. Missing stimulus, approval, console, script or expected encoding prevents execution readiness but does not make the library case permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects its BMC SEL substitution and truncated capture as primary proof while retaining SEL as supplemental evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its safe evidence plan but reclassifies the case to MANUAL ONLY because BIOS observation and setting manipulation are core acceptance actions.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates human BIOS acceptance, automatable supporting collection, execution status and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a successful BMC SEL query or clear from being reported as a successful SMBIOS Event Log test and defines auditable evidence on both sides of the destructive erase.
independent_technical_reasoning: The decisive evidence exists inside named BIOS pages before and after a destructive setting change and reset. Even if event generation and supporting collection are automated, the human UI observation and manipulation remain core; V3.1 therefore classifies the case MANUAL ONLY, not PARTIAL.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat the stimulus, clear or reset automatically after a mismatch; preserve all evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
